blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—NBA legend Dwyane Wade was in attendance during the match between University of Santo Tomas and Far Eastern University in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Smart Araneta Coliseum on Wednesday. Wade did a little bit of everything courtside, from watching the game to making a brief appearance at the commentary table.
